'''RFC Seraing''' is a Belgian association football club based in [[Seraing]] in the province of [[Liège (province)|Liège]]. They play their home games at the [[Stade du Pairay]]. The club currently compete in [[Challenger Pro League]], the second tier of Belgian football."}}
